Sparkling Tones, part three: the preset card.
Tap any preset, and its card slides up: family, categories, notes, and everything you can do with it.
"Play" sends it to the amp, without touching any of the eight slots.
"Copy" makes a duplicate in your library, so you can experiment without losing the original.
"Put in a slot" writes the preset into the amp. Pick the slot, confirm, and it's there.
The preset that was in that slot isn't lost: it simply moves down into your library.
Sparkling Tones: free, and it works offline. Next: the editor.
